summary: Filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Dr. Reddy's Laboratories Ltd., a foreign private issuer, to announce the timing of its Q4 and full-year FY26 earnings release and earnings call scheduled for May 12, 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is referenced. The filing is a routine earnings calendar notice with no material corporate action or structural change. As a routine operational update, it does not qualify as a special situation under event-driven research criteria.
